You lose 1 {Category} point, which you don't get back before the next operation, and another bond is weakened by 1 point, then roll a die. 1: They reject you and you lose 1 {AbilityName}; 2–5: the Bond starts at the die minus 2; 6: it starts at 3, and you get the {Category} point back.

investigator.GoneReminder: One last act, then the Agent is lost: time for a new character.
